Discover and protect AI agents with Microsoft Defender (Preview)
Feedback
Summarize this article for me
Microsoft Defender detects all Copilot Studio custom AI agents in your tenant and provides tools to identify misconfigured or potentially risky agents, and collects data from Copilot Studio for use in
advanced hunting
.
Prerequisites
To enable AI agent inventory and detection, you must:
Have a Microsoft Agent 365 license
Until July 1, 2026, you can access the Copilot Studio AI agent inventory and detection without a Microsoft Agent 365 license if you:
Have a Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps license
Opt in to the
Microsoft Defender for Cloud apps and Defender XDR preview features
Enable discovery of Copilot Studio AI agents
After you turn on the Security for AI setting in the Microsoft Defender portal, Microsoft Defender automatically discovers all Copilot Studio custom AI agents in your tenant. You can then view your agents in the
AI agent inventory
. Use
advanced hunting
to investigate potential threats and misconfigurations.
Note
The onboarding process for the AI agent inventory requires collaboration with Power Platform administrators.
To enable the Copilot Studio AI agent inventory, follow these steps:
Sign in to the
Microsoft Defender portal
as the System Administrator.
Go to
System > Settings > Security for AI
.
Turn on
Security for AI Agents
. Enabling Copilot Studio AI Agents confirms that you read the disclaimer and agree to use the Microsoft Defender AI agent protection features.
Work together with the Power Platform administrator to complete these steps in the
Power Platform Portal
:
Go to
Security
->
Threat Protection
.
Select
Microsoft Defender - Copilot Studio AI Agents
.
Turn on
Enable Microsoft Defender - Copilot Studio AI Agents
.
When Copilot Studio AI Agents are connected, a green indicator appears in the
AI Agents Inventory
section in the Microsoft Defender system settings. The initial connection status can take up to 30 minutes to update. Depending on the size and complexity of your environment, it might take longer to see the full deployment of the AI agent inventory.
